words.definition_en: A dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families.
extra_definitions: [noun] A structure built or serving as an abode of human beings.
[noun] The people who live in a house; a household.
[noun] A building used for something other than a residence (typically with qualifying word).
words.example: He has a house on Cape Cod.

words.definition_en: The part of a thoroughfare between the sidewalks; the part of the thoroughfare on which vehicles travel.
extra_definitions: [noun] A paved part of road, usually in a village or a town.
[noun] A road as above but including the sidewalks (pavements) and buildings.

words.definition_en: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation.
extra_definitions: [noun] A way used for travelling between places, originally one wide enough to allow foot passengers and horses to travel, now (US) usually one surfaced with asphalt or concrete and designed to accommodate many vehicles travelling in both directions. In the UK both senses are heard: a country road is the same as a country lane.
[noun] A road; or particularly a car, as a means of transportation.

words.definition_en: A trifling sum of money.

[noun] (by extension) A person or thing of little importance or value.

words.definition_en: A street that is primarily used to gain access to the property bordering it.
words.definition_vi: Đường phố được sử dụng chủ yếu để tiếp cận khu đất giáp ranh với nó.

words.definition_en: The act of going from one place to another.

words.definition_en: A journey or route all the way around a particular place or area.
